pricing.retail_note: Anchor = Camiseta Padrao, one large print. Owner R$109,90 (crossed-out R$139,90). Per-model prices are in pricing.models, generated by br/scripts/br_pricing.py (see br/docs/pricing.md). Gubo card cost seen in the 2026-11-07 probe: R$54,53 (P-GG), R$62,95 (XG/XGG).

pricing.models_note: Generated by br/scripts/br_pricing.py (proportional method, see br/docs/pricing.md). Do not hand-edit; change the inputs there. Sizes of models other than PD are UNVERIFIED until the catalog sync reads Gubo.
pricing.compare_at_note: Display only (crossed-out price). The US store shows no compare-at price; this is the owner's BR marketing device (R$139,90 -> R$109,90).
